name: Question 9
problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $U,$ given by

$$
U=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 6 \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 4\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $U?$

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\ {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$
